=====================================
Welcome to daoEkarus's Documentation!
=====================================

Overview
--------
daoEkarus is the adaptive optics real-time control system for the Ekarus instrument on the 1.8m copernico telescope at Cima Ekar. This documentation provides a comprehensive guide to understanding and utilizing the daoEkarus system effectively.
